patch.summary: HubSpot migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to HubSpot by inventorying legacy crm fields, mapping them to HubSpot objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Gmail, Slack before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: HubSpot migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management, lead management, pipeline management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into HubSpot; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Gmail; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when SMB and mid-market teams wanting free CRM now and room to expand into hubs later outweigh migration cost

Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.
If HubSpot mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Pipedrive before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Gmail in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Sales Hub Professional starts at list pricenth per seat on the Product & Services Catalog and the Sales product page (re-checked 2026-08-18). HubSpot’s Sales pricing page also shows list price billed annually vs list price monthly, plus required Professional onboarding (list price). Starter marketing prices show new-customer discounts (*).

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Full GTM stack (Marketing Hub, Service Hub, etc.) is sold as additional hubs with their own seat/contact pricing — not included in Free CRM alone.

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.
